Marriage to more than one spouse at the same time; in Zimbabwe, polygyny (one husband, several wives).
A monogamous marriage solemnised and registered by a marriage officer such as a magistrate or authorised minister.
A marriage concluded by custom, usually with roora/lobola; may be registered; may be polygamous under customary law.

front: What is the minimum marriage age in Zimbabwe?
back: 18 (section 78 of the Constitution); both parties must consent.

front: Which law reformed marriage in Zimbabwe in 2022?
Give two possible advantages of polygamy in indigenous farming society.
back: More family labour for farming; care within a household for widows or for a wife unable to have children.
Rivalry and jealousy; resources spread thin and inheritance disputes (also health risks, unequal power).

front: Why should a customary marriage be registered?
back: Registration gives legal proof, protecting spouses' rights to property, inheritance and maintenance.
